notes: Eval 1 rebuilds the bundled worked example and must reproduce it exactly (the runtime contract). Evals 2 and 3 run the skill on a fresh app; their assertions are about grounding, structure and honesty, not taste.

evals.name: example-rebuilds-clean
assertions: the page shows 37 ideas, 5 motions, 6 walkthrough steps, 8 first-batch items
every .stage[data-demo] plays without 'Demo failed' and the console has zero errors
jumping to walkthrough step 5 leaves exactly one ticker line and T-5 in Complete
no horizontal overflow at 390 px in light and dark

evals.name: running-app-with-url
evals.prompt: /bespoke-agentics:micro-interactions http://localhost:3000 — come up with micro-interactions for the flows in this app
assertions: discovery.md lists 4-7 flows with who causes each state change and where its outcome lands
motions already shipping in the app's CSS appear with status 'ships'
the vocabulary has 4-6 motions and names one signature with the app rule it comes from
every idea's 'where' names a function that exists in the repo (grep finds it)
every idea's 'reduced' field is non-empty and is not 'nothing'
no form was submitted and no app source file changed (git status clean outside the output folder)
behavior changes are listed separately in the final report
build.py check is clean and the page opens with no console errors

evals.name: code-only-small-app
evals.prompt: /bespoke-agentics:micro-interactions --no-serve — ideas for the checkout flow, the app isn't running
assertions: discovery.md says 'from code, not seen running' and page.json read_from says 'code only'
ideas are scoped to the checkout flow only and are not padded (fewer than 25 is acceptable)
tokens.css values all trace to a file in the repo (no invented hex values)
